CommunityApplications.Profile:
Discovarr is a media request and discovery manager for a self-hosted library: users browse a catalog, request movies or individual TV seasons, and approved requests are handed to Radarr and Sonarr for download. Statuses reconcile back from those services on a schedule, and titles already in the library are labelled instead of being requested twice.
The repository holds the source (Node 24, zero runtime dependencies, SQLite), the Dockerfile that builds the image, and the Unraid template for the container.
Support goes through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/DaPrKid/Discovarr/issues). Please include your Discovarr version, the container log from startup, and what you were doing in the app.
